messages:
From: Alice Morrison <alice.morrison@vectorscale.com>
To: jonas_weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@vectorscale.com
Date: 2027-06-10T09:12:00Z
Subject: VectorScale SOC 2 RFI - telemetry and evidence ask

Jonas, thank you for the initial control mapping you provided last week. The internal review team surfaced a few follow-ups specific to telemetry and evidence items for our SOC 2 review. Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by June 21 so we can keep the external audit timeline intact?

1) Sample telemetry extracts for a 7-day window (anonymized) showing request traces, timestamps, and upstream model routing decisions.
2) Mapping table that ties telemetry fields/events to SOC 2 common criteria and control IDs.
3) Artifact list and access instructions for log archives, retention policy docs, and key rotation proof (KMS audit entries).
4) Point-of-contact for any technical walkthroughs and redaction/PII handling notes.

We attached the RFI workbook with tabs for SIG and SOC 2 where we've annotated questions (VecScale_RFI_Sig.xlsx). If you can confirm scope and next steps, procurement will align on an NDA amendment for the audit access.

Best,
Alice Morrison
Head of InfoSec Programs
VectorScale

Hi Alice — thanks for the clear list. We're able to provide everything you asked for; below is the proposed delivery and next steps.

Delivery items (target by 2027-06-18):
- Telemetry sample (anonymized) — will include request_id, timestamp, node_route, model_variant, latency_ms, batching_bucket, and cache_hit flag. File: telemetry-sample-anon.txt
- Control mapping spreadsheet — full crosswalk between telemetry fields/events and SOC 2 common criteria + SIG control references. File: RSW_Control_Mapping_VecScale.xlsx
- Artifact manifest & access instructions — retention_policy.pdf link, kms_rotation_summary.pdf (redacted), and S3 path with pre-signed URLs for auditors.

Action items:
1) Please confirm which auditors will need access and whether we should share time-limited S3 links or a read-only Drive folder.
2) Jasmine can run a 45-minute technical walkthrough of the telemetry schema and field redaction policy — suggested slots next week (Tue/Wed morning PT).
3) Neha will coordinate legal on the NDA amendment for audit access.

Attachments: RSW_Control_Mapping_VecScale.xlsx (attachment stub)

I will also provide a short memo describing how our runtime annotates model routing decisions (to show evidence for the "logical access" and "change management" controls). If that covers what you need, we'll schedule the walkthrough and begin packaging the artifacts.

1) Artifacts uploaded (read-only, expiring links valid 2027-06-14 to 2027-07-01):
- Control mapping spreadsheet: https://s3.redwood-inference.com/vecscale-rfi/artifacts/RSW_Control_Mapping_VecScale.xlsx

- Mapping rows show which SOC 2 control each field supports (CC6.1 — change mgmt; CC7.3 — logical access logging; etc.).

3) Walkthrough: Jasmine will send a calendar invite for Tue 2027-06-15 10:00 PT with a short deck and a demo account to step through a sample trace.

If BlueRock needs live access to any systems, we'll coordinate a time-boxed session with our security team and require the standard auditor access form signed (link in Drive).

Thanks — reach out if anything else is needed.
